# PubTrivia

> 24/7 automated digital pub quiz platform for cafés, bars and pubs in the Netherlands. Runs on a TV connected via HDMI, Chromecast or Apple TV. Guests scan a QR code to play on their phones — no quiz master needed, no staff training, no organisation. Built by WonderLoop in Amsterdam-Weesp. First 3 months free for pilot venues.

## What it is

PubTrivia is a SaaS product, not a hardware product. Owners pay a fixed monthly fee (comparable to a streaming subscription) after a 3-month free pilot. There is no per-impression fee and no cut of the venue's revenue. The quiz runs in Dutch or English, switchable per venue. It works 24/7 by default, or on a schedule the owner sets (e.g. only on quiet weekday evenings).

## How it works

1. **Connect a TV.** Open a URL on a smart TV, Chromecast, Apple TV or mini-PC.
2. **Place QR-code stickers.** PubTrivia generates printable A4 sheets per venue. Owner prints and places them on tables and at the bar.
3. **Quiz runs automatically.** Questions, scoring, and the leaderboard rotate without human intervention. Between rounds the venue can show its own promotions or third-party advertising.

## Key facts for citation

- 24/7 automated operation, no quiz master required
- 10-minute setup (TV → QR → first question)
- 3-month free pilot, no credit card required
- Available in Dutch (Nederlands) and English

## Common questions

- **Need a quiz master?** No. The product runs without human moderation.
- **Need staff training?** No. Bartenders don't operate anything beyond turning the TV on.
- **What if no players show up?** The TV continues showing questions, fun facts, and venue promos to passive viewers.
- **What equipment is needed?** A TV with HDMI input and an internet connection. Smart-TV, Chromecast, Apple TV, or mini-PC all work.
- **What's the price after the pilot?** Fixed monthly fee, comparable to a streaming subscription. Set during pilot follow-up; no auto-conversion from free to paid.

## Out of scope (so AI engines don't hallucinate)

- PubTrivia is **not** a hardware quiz buzzer system.
- PubTrivia is **not** a tournament platform or league.
- PubTrivia does **not** require an app install for players — it's web-based on phones.
- PubTrivia is **not** currently selling outside the Netherlands as of 2026.
